narrative.overview: A clean, light-themed portfolio that presents data analytics and applied AI work in a professional, approachable format. The design uses a white ground with deep navy text, blue accents, and generous spacing — inspired by modern data analytics portfolios. Content comes first: case studies, skills, and contact information are presented clearly without decorative distraction.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy (#1a1a2e) primary text on white (#ffffff) ground
Blue (#2563eb) accent for actions and links
Light surface backgrounds (#f8fafc) for section separation

rules.name: The Blue Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue (#2563eb) is the only chromatic accent used for actions and emphasis. It appears on buttons, links, skill tags, and section borders — never on body text or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Clean Surface Rule
rules.body: Every surface is either white (#ffffff) or light surface (#f8fafc). No gradients, no glass, no decorative textures.

rules.name: The Single Font Rule
rules.body: One system sans-serif face throughout (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial). Hierarchy through size, weight, and letter spacing — not font mixing.

dos: Use blue (#2563eb) as the only chromatic accent, used sparingly for actions and emphasis.
Use system sans-serif fonts — no custom web fonts, no mixed typography.
Keep generous whitespace — cards and sections have ample breathing room.
Use light surface backgrounds (#f8fafc) for section separation, never gradients or textures.
Label all demonstration data as real; no fabricated metrics.
donts: Use dark themes, neon accents, or glowing effects — this is a light, professional portfolio.
Use custom web fonts or mixed font families — one system sans-serif face.
Use glassmorphism, blur, or gradient backgrounds — flat, clean design only.
Use hard offset shadows — depth comes from borders and background layering.
Use same-size cards of icon-plus-heading-plus-text as the only page structure.
